notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador interfaces and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It deletes two objects at one receiver, verifies a time-constrained receive-order removal is gated until standard Enable Asynchronous Delivery, then distinguishes that ordinary callback from timestamped removal and checks timestamp metadata before the corresponding grant.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and timestamped Delete Object Instance, Enable/Disable Asynchronous Delivery, object publication and registration, time-role and time-advance services with FederateAmbassador ordinary and timestamped Remove Object Instance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management and time-management declarations
